returns.twrCumulativeDesc: Time-weighted return since inception. Eliminates cash flow effects — reflects portfolio management skill.
returns.twrYtdDesc: Time-weighted return since January 1 this year.
returns.twr1yDesc: Time-weighted return over the trailing 12 months.
returns.mwrXirrDesc: Money-weighted return (XIRR). Reflects actual investor experience including timing of deposits and withdrawals. Diverges from TWR when large cash flows occur.

howToRead.title: How to Read Attribution
howToRead.intro: This view shows relative contribution vs benchmark, not absolute profit ranking.
howToRead.note1: If a class loses money but you are underweight it, it can still show a positive contribution.
howToRead.note2: If a class makes money but you are underweight a strong benchmark class, it can show a negative contribution.
howToRead.note3: For absolute gain/loss by class, use the Performance by Class table in the Overview tab.

sharpe.title: Sharpe Ratio
sharpe.description: Risk-adjusted return per unit of total volatility. > 1.0 is good.

sortino.title: Sortino Ratio
sortino.description: Risk-adjusted return per unit of downside volatility. > 2.0 is excellent.

drawdown.title: Max Drawdown
drawdown.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline. Lower is better.

calmar.title: Calmar Ratio
calmar.description: Annualized return ÷ Max Drawdown. > 1.0 is good.

volatility.title: Annual Volatility
volatility.description: Annualized standard deviation of returns. Lower = less risk.

return.title: Total Return
return.description: Overall portfolio return since first data point.

risk.limitedDataVolatility: High volatility may reflect limited data.
